_doc: Cells & Chemistry — cell manufacturers and battery OEM cell units. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

catl.one_liner: World's largest EV & ESS battery maker.
catl.product: Li-ion cells, EV packs, ESS containers

byd.one_liner: Chinese EV + battery maker; the LFP Blade Battery.

lg energy solution.one_liner: Korean cell major; NMC pouch/cylindrical for global OEMs.

samsung sdi.one_liner: Korean cell maker; prismatic & cylindrical, premium NMC.

sk on.one_liner: Korean pouch-cell maker; Ford BlueOval SK JV.

northvolt.one_liner: European cell maker founded by ex-Tesla exec Peter Carlsson; Revolt recycling.

tesla.one_liner: EV & energy pioneer; in-house 4680 cell + Megapack ESS.

gotion.one_liner: Chinese LFP cell maker; VW is a major shareholder.

eve energy.one_liner: Chinese cell maker; large-format LFP + 46-series cylindrical.

sunwoda.one_liner: Chinese cell manufacturer spanning consumer electronics and EV batteries.

china bak.one_liner: Chinese cylindrical Li-ion cell manufacturer (formerly Nasdaq-listed as CBAK Energy Technology).

lishen.one_liner: Chinese battery maker (Tianjin Lishen); early consumer-electronics cell supplier, now also EV cells.

solid power.one_liner: US solid-state battery developer; partnered with BMW and Ford.

24m technologies.one_liner: US developer of SemiSolid electrode technology, licensed to cell makers including FREYR Battery.

one.one_liner: US battery maker (Our Next Energy); dual-chemistry "Gemini" pack and LFP cells, backed by BMW.

freyr battery.one_liner: US/Norwegian battery company building gigafactories; licenses 24M Technologies' SemiSolid process.

verkor.one_liner: French battery maker building a gigafactory in Dunkirk; backed by Renault.

acc.one_liner: European cell-manufacturing joint venture (Automotive Cells Company) between Stellantis, Mercedes-Benz and TotalEnergies (Saft), with gigafactories in France, Germany and Italy.

inobat.one_liner: Slovak EV battery developer and gigafactory builder.

morrow batteries.one_liner: Norwegian LFP cell maker building a gigafactory in Arendal, Norway.

storedot.one_liner: Israeli developer of extreme fast-charging (XFC) battery technology.

enovix.one_liner: US maker of silicon-anode 3D cell architecture, initially for consumer electronics.

factorial energy.one_liner: US solid-state battery developer (FEST technology); partnered with Mercedes-Benz and Stellantis.

ses ai.one_liner: US developer of hybrid lithium-metal batteries; backed by GM and Hyundai.

rept battero.one_liner: Chinese cell manufacturer (RuiPu Lanjun / REPT BATTERO).

wanxiang.one_liner: Chinese industrial conglomerate; owns US battery maker A123 Systems, acquired out of bankruptcy in 2013.

skeleton technologies.one_liner: Estonian supercapacitor maker using graphene-based "Curved Graphene" electrodes.

form energy.one_liner: US developer of iron-air batteries for multi-day grid energy storage.

aesc.one_liner: Cell manufacturer originally Nissan's in-house battery arm; majority-owned by China's Envision Group since 2019 (Envision AESC).

calb.one_liner: Chinese cell manufacturer (China Aviation Lithium Battery), a major LFP and NMC cell supplier.

farasis energy.one_liner: Chinese-founded pouch-cell manufacturer with operations in China, the US and Germany.

svolt.one_liner: Chinese cell manufacturer spun out of Great Wall Motor.

microvast.one_liner: US-headquartered, China-founded battery maker focused on commercial-vehicle and industrial cells.

saft.one_liner: French battery-cell maker (industrial, defense, backup power); part of TotalEnergies. Co-owns the ACC cell joint venture.
